subject: Order Form & DPA consolidation plan and procurement checklist
messages:
From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@healthcore.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Pedro Alvarez <pedro@healthcore.com>, Megan Liu <megan.liu@hc-legal.com>
Date: Sat, 09 Sep 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: HealthCore redlines: DPA + transfer addendum

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the call earlier. Attaching our redline of Redwood's DPA and a short transfer-impact addendum we'd like to include in the order form (see attachments). High level: our legal team wants clarification on controller/processor roles for edge-case export flows and a definitive carve-out for customer data exports to third-party analytics vendors.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can accept SCCs with the controller/processor split as proposed (we highlighted wording)
- If you can include the transfer addendum as an exhibit to the order form or if it needs to be a separate amendment

We'd prefer to avoid multiple redlines across the MSA/order form — is there a single owner on your side who can coordinate procurement/legal consolidation?

Attachments: HealthCore_DPA_Redline_20280908.docx, DPA_Transition_Addendum-draft.pdf

Best,
Samantha Price
Head of Privacy & Compliance
HealthCore Labs

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@healthcore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 09 Sep 2028 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthCore redlines: DPA + transfer addendum

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the clarity and the single addendum approach. Looping in Ben (sales lead) and Karthik (privacy) plus Steph from legal to consolidate redlines and map to the order form.

Proposed immediate plan:
- Ben to confirm order-form placement (exhibit vs amendment) and update pricing impact if any.
- Karthik to validate SCCs wording and list the minimal evidence package HealthCore should expect.
- Steph to run final legal signoff and confirm if an MSA-level exception is needed.

Can we lock a 30-minute call on Monday (US morning) to walk through the redline and finalize whether the transfer addendum will be an exhibit or separate amendment? I'll send a calendar invite once we have alignment.

Laura Bennett
Head of Contracts & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Samantha Price <samantha.price@healthcore.com>
Cc: Pedro Alvarez <pedro@healthcore.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: HealthCore redlines: DPA + transfer addendum

Laura / Samantha —

Thanks for the ping. From a procurement/order-form perspective: we can fold the transfer addendum in as an exhibit to the order form (preferred) to keep the MSA unchanged. That said, if HealthCore wants the addendum to be broadly referenced across accounts, we should do an amendment. For this deal (RDW-4769) exhibit is cleanest and fastest.

Pricing note: if the addendum restricts certain cross-border hosting options and forces on-prem routing for EU traffic, there may be a routed-cost uplift. I've attached a draft OrderForm_v3.pdf with a placeholder clause for "data routing obligations"; we should agree the redline language before finalizing numbers.

Action items I'll take:
- Update OrderForm_v3.pdf with the exhibit reference to the transfer addendum.
- Flag any cost triggers and provide a short pricing impact memo by end of day Monday.
- Create HubSpot task and link (see related link) so procurement and legal can track signoff.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: OrderForm_v3.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Price <samantha.price@healthcore.com>, Megan Liu <megan.liu@hc-legal.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 07:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthCore redlines: DPA + transfer addendum — SCCs and evidence checklist

Laura, Ben —

Quick note after reviewing Samantha's redline: two items we need to resolve before legal can sign off. I've inlined comments into HealthCore_DPA_Redline_20280908.docx (see attachment) but summarizing: 

1) SCC mapping and roles: the redline makes HealthCore the controller and Redwood the processor in most flows, which is fine. We need explicit language for the rare "analytics vendor" scenario where HealthCore instructs Redwood to send aggregated telemetry to a third-party processor; add a paragraph that requires prior written instruction plus a subprocessor list and an allowable-transfer exception for pseudonymized metrics.

2) Evidence & timeline: provide the minimal evidence set so procurement can close:
- KMS key residency statement (if customer requires)
- Subprocessor roster for the last 12 months
- Export routing diagram (what services touch EU data)

If HealthCore can provide the three items above within 5 business days, I think we can keep this as an exhibit and avoid an MSA-level amendment. Otherwise, we may need a limited amendment to preserve both parties's risk allocation.

I've also attached DPA_Transition_Addendum-draft.pdf with a suggested paragraph for pseudonymized metrics.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachment: DPA_Transition_Addendum-draft.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@healthcore.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: HealthCore redlines: DPA + transfer addendum — next steps and call

Thanks all — good synthesis. Samantha / Pedro / Megan — can you confirm HealthCore can provide the three evidence items Karthik listed within 5 business days? If yes, we will:

- Fold the transfer addendum as an exhibit to OrderForm_v3.pdf (Ben will update).
- Karthik and Steph will run a final compliance/legal sweep once the evidence pack arrives.
- After internal signoff, I'll send the final package to Megan for execution (DocuSign link included).

I've created a short call agenda and proposed two 30-minute slots Monday 09/11 at 10:30 PT and 15:00 PT — please let me know which works. Calendar invite will follow.

Agenda (attachment: meeting_agenda_20280911.docx):
- 10 min: walk through the key redline points (SCC mapping + pseudonymized metrics)
- 10 min: order form placement and pricing triggers
- 10 min: agree evidence timeline + signoff owner
